name: Synthe commit barrier
description: Blocks direct git pushes and shows what waits for your approval in Synthe

brokerSocket.description: The Synthe broker address (unix:///path/to/broker.sock or tcp://127.0.0.1:8791); default $SYNTHE_BROKER

blockDirectPush.description: Block tool calls that would push or publish to a git remote around Synthe

statusLine.description: Add one line of Synthe status (waiting approvals, last receipt) to each turn
